notes.title: Update 1.0.58.3665
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/b55c1a39328f3078b2dfe2987a2a9848d16f9c46.png"][/img][/p][p]Atman confrontation quest fixes and minor balance adjustments.[/p][h3]Fixes in the Atman confrontation quest chain:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when moving certain quest items from the Atmans confrontation chain to the base warehouse.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where quest items for the Atman confrontation quest chain dropped even without the corresponding quests has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Quest items from the Atman confrontation quest chain can now be thrown overboard, which will allow getting rid of items that were obtained due to an error.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where it was impossible to get the "Spare Parts" quest from NPC Ashley on the aircraft carrier  to obtain Atman Weapon Fragments has been fixed. This repeatable quest is now correctly issued.[/p][/*][*][p]A quest objective marker has been added in the aircraft carrier quest to destroy the Atman flagship.[/p][/*][*][p]The reward for repeatable Atman quests has been increased from 5000 to 15000 medallions.[/p][/*][*][p]The chance of medallions dropping from Atman ships no longer depends on the presence of active quests for obtaining their items for repeatable quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Text and localization fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Increased power gain from funnels, air intakes, and fan motors:[/h3][list][*][p]Power gain from "Huge Funnel" Level 5 has been increased from 300,000 to 420,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Midsize Funnel" Level 4 has been increased from 120,000 to 170,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Warship Air Intake" Level 5 has been increased from 72,000 to 104,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Power gain from "Steamship Air Intake" Level 4 has been increased from 26,000 to 36,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Base power of Fan Motors of Rank 3-5 has been increased by 33%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes in weapon characteristics:[/h3][list][*][p]Machine Gun Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 10 to 16.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenade Launcher Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 30 to 60.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Grenade Launchers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bonus to explosion radius from structures has been reduced from 2 to 1 meter (except for Three-Story Cabin and Abrams turret base).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Shotguns:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 120 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Bullet damage falloff with distance has been reduced by 20% (effective range increased).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Flamethrowers:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Maximum range has been increased from 80 to 100 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 120 to 150.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Minor adjustments to grenade launchers and machine guns were planned to be implemented  in the update 1.0.52.3655, but were postponed to collect more statistics and analyze them. These two weapon types show higher than expected effectiveness, but due to their high popularity among players, we decided not to directly reduce their damage, but to limit it over a long firing interval by increasing energy consumption per shot. At the same time, shotguns and flamethrowers, despite their high damage, are unable to realize it due to the need for close combat with the enemy. We hope that increasing the effective attack range will allow these weapon types to find more fans.[/p][p][b]"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"[/b][/p][list][*][p]Energy consumption reduced from 210 to 140.[/p][/*][/list][p]Comment: Although this installation is not a full-fledged weapon type, we hope that such a reduction in energy consumption will allow it to be combined with shotguns and flamethrowers for safe approach to enemies in PvP events.[/p][p][b]Dreadripper[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun durability has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Minigun damage has been increased by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]To sink Dreadripper, it is now necessary to blow up 5 fuel tanks instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Erroneous display of the boss marker in separate locations intended for battles with other bosses has been disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Display of the boss marker for players on ships below Rank 4 has been disabled.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Hull Material Changes[/h3][p][b]Plastic Sheathing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Speed bonus has been increased from 20% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Ship mass reduction bonus has been improved from -30% to -40%.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Wood Sheathing:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Resistance to burning damage disabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Metal notes.title: Update 1.0.51.3640
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/62d41b335cc20033be05fffa3656b43b403943cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In this update, the hulls of the Glare Rocket Boat and the Torpedo Boat Midori have been slightly nerfed, while the Grasp Tugboat and the ST Octa Seiner have been buffed to increase the demand for them and open up new tactical possibilities.[/p][p]Machine guns—as one of the most popular and versatile weapon types—have been tweaked to make them more balanced, especially in PvP. The minigun can still fire all 480 rounds without overheating, but if you increase its magazine size with structural bonuses it may now overheat. You can avoid overheating by assigning the minigun to a crew member with the “Knowledge of Physics” skill.[/p][p]We’ve also paid attention to grenade launchers: thanks to the increased projectile velocity, firing them is now more convenient, which we hope will attract new fans to this weapon class.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support![/p][h2]Full changelog[/h2][h3]Changes to ship characteristics:[/h3][p]Grasp Tugboat:[/p][list][*][p]Reverse thrust power increased to 40% of forward power.[/p][/*][/list][p]ST Octa Seiner:[/p][list][*][p]Base displacement increased from 600,000 to 620,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Hull mass increased from 200,000 to 260,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Rudder angle and area adjusted (combined with the higher mass, turning stability should improve significantly).[/p][/*][/list][p]Glare Rocket Boat:[/p][list][*][p]Base hull side durability reduced from 2350 to 2200.[/p][/*][/list][p]Torpedo Boat Midori:[/p][list][*][p]Base hull side durability reduced from 3600 to 3300.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Changes to weapon characteristics:[/b][/h3][p]Machine Guns:[/p][list][*][p]Optimal range for all machine guns reduced to 200 m. Damage beyond that will taper off down to 10% at maximum range.[/p][/*][*][p]Structural bonus to reload time reduction lowered from 25% to 15%.[/p][/*][/list][p]Grenade Launchers:[/p][list][*][p]Projectile speed increased from 208 to 312.[/p][/*][*][p]Range increased from 500 m to 1000 m; structural range bonuses removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Structural bonus to explosion radius is now +2 m (up from +1 m on some structures).[/p][/*][/list][p]Dreadripper Minigun :[/p][list][*][p]Now subject to overheating.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Pump power consumption increased by 20%; pump efficiency decreased by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss behind the “Hunt for the ‘Scuttlefish’ (Group)” teleport: weapon damage and module durability increased 2–3x; hull durability raised from 4,000,000 to 6,000,000.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrap Copper requirement for Mechanism Parts increased from 4 to 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Diesel Generator recipe: Chemical Waste replaced by Scrap Copper.[/p][/*][*][p]Radioisotope Generator recipe: Chemical Waste replaced by Copper Plates.[/p][/*][*][p]Holding down the fire button now makes cannons and rockets auto-fire the next shot as soon as reloading completes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/80556e764ce5ff059b49047d8ee9e73f9587323a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear friends! We’ve released an update for Age of Water: new ships and weapons have been added, the new energy system is ready to challenge your construction skills, and PvP rewards have been significantly increased.[/p][p]In this post, we’ll answer the most frequent questions about the balance changes, energy, and weapons. Thank you for your support and feedback: it helps us make the game better![/p][h3][b]Q: What are the main goals and objectives of this update?[/b][/h3][p]A: Our primary aim is to breathe new life into Age of Water and make balancing between speed, firepower, and survivability more challenging and fun. We’ve increased the variety of ships and weapons, rebalanced energy consumption and rewards, and ensured that every choice in the shipbuilder carries weight and encourages fresh tactics.[/p][h3][b]Q: How do I rebuild my top-tier ship in light of the new changes?[/b][/h3][p]A: Now there isn’t enough energy to power everything you want, so plan carefully! We recommend first removing any extra Fan Motor modules and adding structures that boost energy production. For example, the "Torpedo Boat Midori Cabin" and the "Rook Boat Cabin A" now provide huge energy bonuses, but, as with many other cabins, they’ve been moved into a new "wheelhouse" category, of which you may set up only one per ship. However, there are other cabins and modules that grant energy boosts without that restriction (see the in-game descriptions), such as the "Three-Story Cabin”," "Rook Boat Cabin B," "Rook Boat Cabin C," and the "Halibut Conning Tower." Think through module placement and their energy demands, and balance your ship’s armament, speed, hull durability, and free cargo space to fit the new meta.[/p][h3][b]Q: How can I achieve sufficient energy after the update if I lack resources to craft generators and modules that give them bonuses?[/b][/h3][p]A: The quickest and most cost-effective route is to craft wind generators at your base. They’ll cover basic needs and simple builds.[/p][h3][b]Q: Does it still make sense to craft an expensive Rank 5 radioisotope generator if a cheaper Rank-5 wind generator produces more energy?[/b][/h3][p]A: Wind generators can look more efficient at first glance, but note that they only receive durability bonuses from modules—not energy production bonuses—and each installed wind generator increases the overall energy output penalty for all wind generators.[/p][h3][b]Q: Why did you make such radical changes to familiar gameplay elements?[/b][/h3][p]A: We overhauled the core balance for the long-term health of the game, aiming to add depth and variety to ship and weapon choices. Before the patch, the dominant build was obvious—Midori, cisterns, cannons—leaving little room for alternatives. Now there are many viable builds, making it much harder to declare any single setup "the best."[/p][h3][b]Q: Won’t these updates devalue old content and the time players invested? And why were cannons changed so drastically?[/b][/h3][p]A: We don’t believe old items are devalued. On top-tier builds, standard generators remain the best choice. While weapon balance has shifted—many older weapons have actually become more effective—cannons and rockets, if anything, lost efficiency through higher energy costs rather than reduced damage. Cannons were too universally strong—about 75% of players used only them—so we increased their energy consumption to open the field to other weapon types. Their raw damage remains the same, but in the new energy scarcity meta they no longer feel as dominant. Energy efficiency and build strategy now matter as much as sheer damage output.[/p][p]We understand this may be uncomfortable for the players who were used to their ship builds. But we hope that new opportunities and challenges will introduce you to different weapon setups while we continue keeping an eye out on the weapon balance.[/p][h3][b]Q: How has the maximum speed of ships changed after the rebalance?[/b][/h3][p]A: Gone are the days of 200-knot flying boats (with rare exceptions). With a well-planned build—say, ten Level 6 cannons—you can still reach a comfortable 80–130 knots, depending on your hull choice.[/p][h3][b]Q: Why disable multiple respawn points and limit respawning to the Three Whales?[/b][/h3][p]A: By leaving only one respawn point at the Three Whales, we’ve raised the stakes for each life. Returning to your death spot now requires using a translocator—and possibly a powerbank to recharge it. We also disabled forced cargo drops on death so you can decide whether to return to the place of your demise or move on.[/p][h3][b]Q: What do you hope to achieve with these changes?[/b][/h3][p]A: We aim for a balance in which every player can build a ship tailored to their play style or a specific activity, weighing survivability, firepower, and speed. We also updated repair costs—previous resource requirements didn’t match gameplay realities, so most players repaired only hulls. Now that ship preservation is vital, lower repair costs will help.[/p][h3][b]Q: What data will you focus on after the update? Which feedback is most important?[/b][/h3][p]A: We’re closely monitoring event statistics, ship and weapon selections, and player feedback on energy and weapon balance. We want to know what challenges you face when rebuilding your ship, whether your generators are sufficient, and your thoughts on the new meta and weapon balance. Your insights will guide our future balance decisions.[/p][h3][b]Q: Will you continue to make balance tweaks going forward?[/b][/h3][p]A: We’ve already [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2695490#scrollTop=333.3333435058594"]released one balance patch[/url] and will continue to track the situation and apply further adjustments as needed.[/p]

notes.title: Crew Progression – Your Key to Power
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/8ea782b8a99d6c5f4ed1b0994e5f0efeb4266eb4.jpg[/img]

In Age of Water, a ship’s strength is determined not only by its hull and weapons but also by the crew’s level of training. Each crew member has unique skills that can be improved as they gain experience in battles or perform their daily duties. The more experienced the team, the more opportunities open up for the captain!
Crew skills play a crucial role: a well-trained helmsman can steer higher-ranked ships, while an upgraded crew provides important bonuses—from increased engine power to reduced energy consumption. Moreover, skilled sailors consume less water and food, making long journeys across the vast ocean even more efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/5bd1a277634b7430d3ec6ebd347de96f19ecf01a.jpg[/img]

Character progression requires smart allocation of skill points. For example, gunners should focus on increasing weapon damage and reload speed, while deckhands can repair ship damage faster and optimize energy consumption. Choosing the right abilities also depends on each crew member’s role—it’s essential to consider who is responsible for what on board.
How do you train your crew? Which skills do you prioritize first, and which ones do you save for later? Share your strategies in the comments!

notes.title: Meet the Beyond the Waves update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/970f9211edaf1dfa07b3c6f0d76d7778e2d3cce4.jpg[/img]
We’re proud to present the Beyond the Waves update featuring captivating storylines, powerful weapons and new challenges that are sure to please even the most seasoned captains.
The update introduces an entirely new team-based PvP mode, Control Points, where players must work together to capture and defend strategically important locations scattered across the waters. For those seeking even greater challenges, the game now features five dangerous zones, each guarded by formidable bosses of varying difficulty levels. Additionally, exciting stories await you in a new quest line. Your team will also gain a new crew member.

In this episode, we invite you to face off against a world boss lurking beyond the sector's edge. This unique new enemy will test your combat skills and strategies, delivering an epic battle unlike anything you've seen before in Age of Water.
To help you deal with the enemies more effectively, you can unlock a sixth tier of weapons with devastating firepower, including rocket launchers!

The world of Age of Water has become even more diverse with the addition of ten new land-based combat areas. Your crew will engage in intense close-quarters combat, while you'll need to adapt to new conditions and employ previously unseen tactics.

Dear captains!
We continue to work on improving the game and expanding its content. Today, we’d like to talk about one of the upcoming innovations, namely the new “Auto-loot” module.

Since the launch of the project, we have received a lot of requests for automatic item collection. Players often spend a lot of time gathering loot in an area, which can be time-consuming and distracting from combat.

Therefore, we’re introducing the “Auto-loot” feature into the game, which will be included in one of the upcoming updates. To use this feature, you’ll need to install a special module on the deck of your ship. After installation, loot within a certain radius around your ship will be automatically collected and loaded into the cargo hold. Unlike manual loot collection, the automatic feature does not require key presses or close proximity to items on the water’s surface.

Initially, one version of this module will be introduced, requiring a certain amount of energy and deck space. In the future, we may expand the range of these devices, each with different collection speeds, action radius, and energy consumption.

Stay tuned for updates to ensure you don’t miss the introduction of the “Auto-loot” feature in the game!

notes.title: Gifts for all players! And what we’re working on at the moment
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/d277fed3515e141433e1e2dd4f502aa63f89069f.jpg[/img]

We on the Age of Water development team constantly strive to improve the game, paying special attention to fixing errors based on your feedback. Thank you very much for your numerous messages, which have helped us identify many errors and balance issues.

[h2]All players who log into the game until June 14th 0:00 GMT get gifts![/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/8ed1b4ae3cc88202cafc6a113eda5222698df98d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/aca08805b4fc2bf7b7782757e50f507217bfe0cc.png[/img][/url]
Veteran Earl Access's Bandana

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/f08aef50f88d759b5cbf98f5a7d6c8a5ad5de7c3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/4c20ed95ed072e406b8f97a1a820fb8fc592b65c.png[/img][/url]
Veteran Earl Access's Colours

You can find the paint and the bandanna in the hold of your ship. 

We carefully analyze statistics and feedback to create an engaging game that meets your expectations, and we are now ready to share with you our plans for further improving Age of Water and news about fixes that have been implemented recently.
[h2]Battle Mechanics and Weapon Balance[/h2]
Many players prefer using cannons in the game, so we've decided to slightly reduce their stats for the sake of balance. We want other weapons in the game to be in demand as well. For example, we believe that machine guns should become more effective, as well as grenade launchers and shotguns. Additionally, we plan to rework the energy consumption of weapons in the game.
In the latest updates, we have already reduced the recoil that hulls received from enemy hits. However, their scope still shakes when the player is hit: many have complained about the inconvenience caused by it, and we plan to balance this aspect in the game.
[h2]More Convenient Map Navigation[/h2]
The current map navigation system does not always provide convenient orientation, although we have worked on improving it in recent updates, especially for gamepads. Nevertheless, we have decided to make additional changes.
We want players to find necessary resources or locations more easily, so we need to make the map more readable and informative. We will add various icons for different resources and objects (e.g., mines or loot on the water surface) to provide a clearer and more diverse display of various game elements on the map.
[h2]Events and Battles[/h2]
We continue to monitor cases where enemies may not spawn or quest items may be missing in specified locations. We will keep fixing these types of errors.
There are several variations of top-tier "battles" in the game. We want to make them more diverse and interesting: add more challenging opponents, slightly increase the duration of such battles to make playing both solo and in a squad more enjoyable.
We will also add the option to disable notifications about the start of PvP events to prevent these messages from distracting players from completing tasks.
[h2]Economy and Loot[/h2]
We have already rebalanced the cost of some buildings in the base and will continue to work in this direction. It may be necessary to reduce the amount of resources required for construction. We also plan to change the cost of crafting at the base, but this will require further analysis of how these changes will impact the economy.
Currently, there is an imbalance in obtaining medallions in PvP missions like "Convoy" and "Mangrove Pearl”. Therefore, we are reviewing the reward system to ensure balance.
By the way, we have increased the loot pickup radius for top rank ships to simplify the resource collection for more experienced players who need much more loot than beginners.
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
We are making efforts to fix bugs that occur in the game. Some players report that sometimes the item crafting process can get stuck, and after restarting the game, the item remains uncrafted, but resources are still spent. Over the past few updates, we have fixed similar issues, so if you are still facing such problems, please let us know and provide as much information as possible.

Thank you for your interest in Age of Water! We sincerely thank you for actively participating in the life of the game and for your feedback, which helps it evolve further. Keep sharing bug reports, impressions, and suggestions with us — and we will continue to work on making the game better. Happy sailing!

[h1]Resetting crew skills[/h1]

notes.title: We answer your questions based on your feedback!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936902/0c0b83cbed37bafdd4bd2237fa5cab17e7c65817.jpg[/img]

Captains!

Firstly, we’d like to thank you for your interest in our project! We’re glad you’ve enjoyed Age of Water: The First Voyage and are glad to see how many of you are looking forward to April 18th, the start date for early access of the main Age of Water game. Thank you!

The prologue of the game, available for free, contains only a small part of the content, and only the very beginning of the exciting story that we’ve prepared for you. 

Separately, we’d like to thank the participants of all stages of the closed alpha and beta testing that was held in 2023 and earlier and for your involvement and active support of the project. After April 18th, each player who previously purchased one of the sets to access the CBT will receive their own activation key corresponding to the Steam edition of Age of Water, depending on the cost of the previously purchased set. Keys may take some time to be issued.

Please note that the testing phase was completed last year, and the progress achieved during testing will not be taken into account when completing the current version of the game, and the CBT client cannot be used to enter the game. 

Next, we’d like to answer some questions that we encountered in your reviews and comments. 

[h3]Will it be possible to play Age of Water with friends?[/h3]

Certainly! Age of Water is an open world MMO game where you can meet other players, add them as friends, or join a group to complete a harder task for example. It’s especially interesting to look at the boats of the players that you meet, borrow unusual design solutions, and wonder where that player got a cool deckhouse or weapon for their boat. 

[h3]How will it be possible to communicate with other players?[/h3]

The game will have a general text chat available, where messages in this chat can be seen by all players within a certain radius of each other. Additionally, you’ll be able to send and receive private messages, for example from players on your friends list. And in addition to chat, group players will be able to use the voice chat built into the game. 

[h3]Will there be PvP content in Age of Water?[/h3]

In the open world, you can find PvP events, where you’ll get a notification about the beginning each. In addition to this, there are PvP quests in the campaign plot. We’ll talk about this in more detail in a separate news post. Don’t miss it!

[h3]Can I play with a gamepad?[/h3]

Yes, both the prologue and main version of Age of Water supports control from a gamepad, such as an Xbox or PlayStation.

[h3]How will the progress made be maintained?[/h3]

If you’ve made it to the end of Age of Water: The First Voyage, then after purchasing the full version of Age of Water, you’ll continue to play from the point where you left off the story in the prologue. If the player has not played Age of Water: The First Voyage before, but has purchased and installed the full version of Age of Water on Steam, then they’ll begin the story campaign with a prologue. 
Thank you for your interest and helpful feedback. Don’t forget to add Age of Water to your wishlist, because very soon a continuation of this fascinating post-apocalyptic story awaits you.

notes.title: Part of the Ship, Part of the Crew
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/bc363170e7bcdd2f78a1c3ee26f033e64938859e.jpg[/img]

Greetings, brave captains!
Today we’ll talk about your crew. These are experienced and dependable people who will be your trusted companions. 

Despite their appearance, these guys are excellent assistants, and their hearts burn with flame of camaraderie and friendship. They will gladly take part in all your activities: they’ll pump the water out, patch up holes in the hull, find food, lend you fire support in a battle or rush to board an enemy vessel. Don’t forget to choose who does what, especially in a moment of danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/bdbd7876c22ff39bad94d48b40ad8b17c5169be7.jpg[/img]

Make sure there’s enough food and water for your crew to keep their morale up. While traveling, between battles, they can sort through the garbage, craft new items and repair your boat. 

Every crew member can become even more useful by acquiring various skills: use a certain type of weapon better, repair your vessel faster, place more cargo in the hold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/556d32bb8cb717183efaf240cff80b7c6d9cb437.jpg[/img]

There are many skills, allowing you to customize your team to suit your play style. You can teach your crew using Skill Points that can be acquired by completing missions in your naval adventure.

And by changing roles of your crew members you can for example, make one of the gunners switch from a machine gun to a cannon turret if that suits him better.

So keep your sailors in shape, captains, and show the world who’s the real lord of the seas!

notes.title: Let's go fishing in the Age of Water!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/52d26caa2972c2baf5c714dddebf1fcb19636b4d.jpg[/img]

To survive, each ship's crew needs provisions. What can you find to eat when surrounded only by water? Fish, of course!

Fish can be obtained several ways:
[list]
[*] collect food by searching the rocks encountered along the way;
[*] pick up some fish after a mine explosion or from the body of a dead shark;
[*] catch fresh fish yourself, but for this, you will need to acquire a fishing rod, then after fishing you’ll have to process and cook your catch;
[*] purchase fish from some traders.
[/list]

Fishing is an activity that requires concentration and full immersion in the process, so choose a calm place so as not to be distracted from this meditative occupation by angry sharks and other enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/a0ec68499242743f5b5634fac2d30cd16649458b.jpg[/img]

There are three types of fish: small, medium, and large, each requiring its own bait. You won't catch a big marlin with a puny worm! So you'll have to sweat and improve your fishing skill!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/f434ac438cf5138bea9de5d45c5f585a4d6b2e39.jpg[/img]

To prevent your catch from slipping away, control the fishing rod, keeping the float in the "white zone." The longer the float stays out of the zone, the higher the chance that your fish will slip away and disappear into the depths of the sea.

[quote] For a more successful fishing experience, here's a life hack from Captain 'Alter Ego': "Cast your line, keeping an eye on where the targeted fish is swimming. Properly directed casting will help adjust the movement and intercept even a fish swimming away from you!"[/quote]

After a successful fishing trip, your crew will gladly start processing the catch! After all, who really wants to eat raw fish? You can give orders to process the fish every time you obtain provisions or appoint someone from the crew to be responsible for the food supplies, and then the designated character will do their job without your reminders.

Make sure there is always enough food in your hold. After all, as it is known: "A strong crew is a well-fed crew!"

notes.title: Who can you meet in the vast expanse of the water world?
notes.notes:
There are many interesting people and amazing creatures living in the water world. Some of them work for themselves, others belong to a certain faction group. Today we’ll talk about the two most dangerous ones. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/47579531912c089e7fe397a46b45ed1f86c25735.jpg[/img]

Most often you will come across members of the Sharkee tribe. These encounters are unlikely to be pleasant, because the Sharkees have been at war with humans for many years and immediately open fire to kill. They attack both single boats and well protected caravans with equal eagerness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/7171bf6c63daf6e67fef28ca956d9514ccca4662.jpg[/img]

Once, the ancestors of the Sharkee tribe were also humans and lived in peace with the other inhabitants of the sector but over the time their paths diverged and radiation from the sunken nuclear submarine provoked a series of mutations. How did that happen? This is one of the secrets of the Age of Water world which you will need to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/96210cdb16a1eb9f65ddbc2d7aa1410f982a1b01.jpg[/img]

Another formidable enemy is the representatives of the Order of the Kraken. They are well armed bounty hunters who cause terror for pirates. Crossing them is a dangerous endeavor!

These are just some of the factions of the Age of Water world. Want to know more about the game? Ask questions on the Steam discussion page and we’ll try to answer the most important ones.

notes.title: Constructing and upgrading your dreamboat
notes.notes:
Inhabitants of the water world know one thing for sure: your boat is your home, craft shop and war fortress which are always with you. Meaning, there is no simple answer to the question “which boat is the best?”  It must fit your personal needs and preferences and help to solve your tasks. You are the captain - you decide what your boat is. 

Age of Water gives you the ability to enjoy a broad choice of options while constructing and upgrading your boat and its components tailoring them to your needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/abb7e59f18084cf55c262dd8d11ebeb03a4ce396.jpg[/img]

From the hull plating where selecting materials based on their weight and strength affects speed and durability, to selecting the exact deck layout. Where will the steering column be? How is the captain or gunner protected from the occasional bullet? How many pumps will give you needed safety? What cover can your crew use while under fire? Should you raise the gun position to shoot above the waves or is it better to keep a low profile? What guns and other weaponry can you use in general… Oh, and how can you provide enough power for all of it! You have a pretty infinite number of choices.

While discovering and obtaining new equipment and extracting artifacts from the old civilization, you can upgrade and reconfigure your ship anytime you like to adjust it to your current crew and missions. Who said that half of a school bus is junk? It can make a great and safe wheelhouse!  

Any suitable object from your inventory can be located on the ship’s structure using the possible 14 mounting points using the placement grid, sometimes even one object over another to create a superstructure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/d69e9a73aac2ec7534df8aacb1702f9308c726f1.jpg[/img]

Also, you can collect and recycle different wreckage and trash to stockpile useful materials for repair works and additional protection elements to the construction. 

Last but not least, don't forget how it looks! The ocean likes tidiness and your boat is like a woman - it needs care and a nice look! Assemble a beautiful and practical vessel, and it will help carry you through all the adventure throws at you!

Last week we announced to you, the estimated dates when Age of Water will be available for purchase on Steam. This wonderful news raised several related questions, which we plan to regularly collect on the game's official platforms and prepare answers for you.

Today we will answer the main questions about PVP, game localization and the fate of CBT buyers.

[b]Q. Will you send an activation code to those who purchased the CBT?[/b]
If you purchased one of the Early Access packs back in the summer, you will get a copy of the game once it's launched on Steam.

[b]Q. How much will the game cost and what languages will be featured in the game?[/b]
The release version will feature all the languages that are listed on the game's Steam page (Russian, English, German, French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese). We will tell you about the prices later, stay tuned.

[b]Q. Are there any projects to translate the game into other languages?[/b]
The game is localized into a number of languages at release time. We will see later if it will need any additional language.

Q. Is the game all about PVP?
PvP in the game is optional, mostly you do fight AI enemies etc. in the open world. 

[b]Q. When you say PvP is optional do you mean I can play the game with PvP disabled between players but players are still present or is it more like a private instance where other players (aside from friends I invite) can't join at all?[/b]
As of now you will always witness other players in the game, and they can see you. You won't be able to attack each other unless you deliberately go to a special area. So if you'd like to play the game without ever engaging in PvP activities, you can totally do it.

[b]Q. Will it have a true open world, accessible for all players on the server, or separate maps with a certain player limit?[/b]
It is a "layered" scheme. As in, all the players are on a single server, but they are distributed between different instances. So if you want to play with your friends, you have to make sure you're in the same one

Q. Is this game only an MMO or can we play solo, like making quests to the main lore, etc?
The game has a PvE story-based campaign.

[b]Q. So this game is an MMO. Does it mean that it will be f2p, as most MMO's are?[/b]
Age of Water will be a paid title, you purchase it once and there will be no subscription.

We’ll collect your questions in the future and definitely prepare part two. So, don’t be shy and write to us on all our official pages: Facebook,  X, Instagram, Discord or Steam.

notes.title: Age of Water is a paid game, not an F2P title
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/bbf04ef8a1bcf9de55a4ce437fb4288390ff3fb5.jpg[/img]

The feedback that we get shows that there is still some confusion regarding the game business model, especially since our publisher is predominantly known for the free-to-play games, and online games in general are quite often free-to-play nowadays.

We’d like to clarify that Age of Water is a paid game, not a free-to-play title. You’ll be able to  make a one-time purchase to get access to the game and play the game campaign without paying anything extra. 

Age of Water is not a session-based online PvP game like Crossout or War Thunder, it’s an open world adventure game with particular online features that enrich the gameplay experience. It’s totally possible to follow the story only without engaging in PvP activities or interacting with other players, if you feel like it. On the other hand, you can always invite your friends to have fun together.

Please, feel free to ask any questions via our social media or Steam. We’re closely monitoring your feedback and will be glad to help you understand the game nature better.

notes.title: Available for purchase in Q1 2024
notes.notes:
Gaijin Entertainment and Three Whales studio announce that the new online adventure game Age of Water will be available for purchase in Q1 2024 on Steam. The game is set in a post-apocalyptic water world where all land has been flooded after a global catastrophe. The price and exact release date will be announced later on the official website of the project, and players are welcome to add Age of Water to your Steam wishlist to get all updates in time.

[previewyoutube=ZBanII8Hd-s;full][/previewyoutube]

The Age of Water protagonist travels on a battle boat between scarce settlements of survivors, fights with pirates, extracts artifacts of the lost civilization from the bottom of the sea, transports valuable goods, performs faction tasks, finds new friends and uncovers the secrets of the exciting water world. The player can either follow the story or explore the world independently at their own pace – for example, trade between settlements, board other people's boats, fight other captains in PvP battles, build their own base.

"We warmly thank the participants of the alpha and beta tests that helped us immensely to move forward with the game," says Yuri Miroshnikov, the game's producer. - It was very important for us to create an atmosphere of an exciting sea adventure, in which the player feels like the main character of a wonderful story".

The game will be sold as an Early Access title and will be improved even further based on user feedback, nevertheless this version will allow the players to complete the whole Age of Water story from day one and with no additional cost. Closed Beta participants who purchased one of the Summer 2023 CBT access bundles will receive a similarly priced edition of Age of Water for free on Steam.

Age of Water is a game developed as a part of Gaijin's inCubator program that was created by Gaijin Entertainment to support new and promising game development studios.

More information about the game can be found [url=https://ageofwater.net/en/#/]on the official Age of Water website[/url].
